title: Welcome to Pine Script v6
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Choose Pine for chart-bound series calculations, not general-purpose compute; establish indicator/strategy/library and target version.
rationale: The runtime and feed constrain available results.
acceptance: Describe deployment context and one observable output.

title: First steps
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Open Pine Editor, create minimal v6 indicator, save, add to chart, inspect errors.
rationale: A working minimal baseline isolates environment problems.
acceptance: Compile a close plot and record chart context.

title: First indicator
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Start with inputs, compute a series globally, then plot; add labels only after numerical checks.
rationale: Separating calculations from presentation makes tests reproducible.
acceptance: Compare output against a built-in indicator with identical settings.

title: Next steps
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use the language manual for semantics and the version-specific reference for exact signatures.
rationale: Examples from older versions may compile differently or not at all.
acceptance: Record the version and reference entry of every API used.

title: Execution model
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Model one pass per historical bar for ordinary indicators and recalculation on live updates; distinguish committed state from intrabar rollback.
rationale: Historical OHLC does not reconstruct all live ticks.
acceptance: Capture live close outputs, reload and compare; explicitly test varip behavior.

title: Type system
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Track fundamental/reference types and const < input < simple < series; type an na initialization; check qualifiers at each call.
rationale: A series cannot be cast down to simple merely by changing numeric type.
acceptance: Test a valid simple length and reject an incompatible series length.

title: Script structure
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use a version annotation and exactly one script declaration; keep dependencies and global outputs in clearly ordered sections.
rationale: Local scope and global scope have different rules.
acceptance: Compile a minimal script before adding modules.

title: Identifiers
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use descriptive distinct names; avoid shadowing built-ins and distinguish prices, lengths, and flags.
rationale: Ambiguous identifiers conceal bugs and collisions.
acceptance: Review names and compile after a rename.

title: Declaration statements
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Choose indicator for features, strategy for emulator orders, library for reusable exports; explicitly set behavior-changing arguments.
rationale: Script kinds have distinct capabilities and properties.
acceptance: Verify declared script type matches the expected UI and runtime.

title: Variable declarations
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use = for declaration, := for reassignment, var for persistent state, varip only for intentional intrabar tracking; use typed na.
rationale: Accidental local shadowing or rollback changes state semantics.
acceptance: Test initialization, consecutive bars, live tick and reload.

title: Operators
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Distinguish history [] from collection indexing; guard denominator, apply parentheses and explicit boolean comparisons.
rationale: Operator precedence and unavailable history cause subtle failures.
acceptance: Test first bar, zero denominator and truth table.

title: Conditional structures
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use if/switch for selection; calculate history-dependent functions outside branches; keep restricted plotting calls global.
rationale: Lazy branches can skip required series evaluations.
acceptance: Compare conditional result to an unconditional baseline across skipped bars.

title: Loops
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Prefer built-ins for rolling calculations; cap loop iterations and collection growth; examine v6 changing loop bounds.
rationale: Per-bar nested loops scale with history and can time out.
acceptance: Test empty/singleton/max-size inputs and record profiler cost.

title: Built-ins
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Look up exact name, callable vs variable, parameter qualifiers, return type, overload and version in official reference.
rationale: Namespace familiarity alone is insufficient to generate correct code.
acceptance: Create one API ledger row per overload actually used.

title: User-defined functions
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use typed parameters where needed, return values or tuples, avoid recursion and global scalar reassignment.
rationale: Functions have scope and call-site history semantics.
acceptance: Call on every bar if history dependent; compare two independent call sites.

title: Objects
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use UDTs for named state; treat assignments as references unless explicit copy semantics are verified.
rationale: Aliasing and rollback can change multiple apparent objects.
acceptance: Mutate an alias and a separate object in a controlled probe.

title: Enums
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use enumerated states for mode and regime choices; map to explicit output strings or numbers.
rationale: Avoids arbitrary strings and ambiguous state values.
acceptance: Exercise every member and document serialized representation.

title: Methods
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use typed receiver in user-defined methods; verify method versus namespace forms and return types.
rationale: Method chaining can hide mutations and type mismatches.
acceptance: Compare method call with equivalent namespace form where supported.

title: Arrays
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use bounded arrays for finite samples and queues; check size before read/pop; distinguish history from index.
rationale: Invalid index and growing collections can halt scripts.
acceptance: Test empty, full, eviction and reset paths.

title: Matrices
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use matrices for genuinely two-dimensional data; track rows/columns and element type.
rationale: Shape errors and repeated large copies are expensive.
acceptance: Test small known matrix and dimension mismatch handling.

title: Maps
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use maps for keyed lookups, verify key type and missing-key behavior, bound size.
rationale: Missing keys and reference values need explicit policy.
acceptance: Test missing, overwrite, remove and clear.

title: Overview
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Select overlay vs pane by units; separate numeric exports from visual presentation; inspect plot budgets.
rationale: Price and oscillator scales must not distort each other.
acceptance: Toggle UI off and compare feature values unchanged.

title: Backgrounds
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use background color only for broad context; set transparency and neutral/missing states.
rationale: Strong fills obscure price bars and imply certainty.
acceptance: Check dark/light charts and no-data state.

title: Bar coloring
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use barcolor for optional event/regime context; use na for no override.
rationale: Default candle meaning must remain visible.
acceptance: Test toggle restores ordinary bar colors.

title: Bar plotting
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use plotbar/plotcandle for computed OHLC only; validate input order and mark synthetic series.
rationale: Synthetic candles are not necessarily executable market prices.
acceptance: Compare known OHLC input and missing data behavior.

title: Colors
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use color.new or explicit color definitions; reserve color semantics and add redundant text/shape.
rationale: Transparency, theme and accessibility affect interpretation.
acceptance: Inspect light/dark and color-vision-friendly distinction.

title: Fills
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Choose fill for compatible plot/hline handles, linefill for line objects; bound zones.
rationale: Mixing incompatible ID types or stale zones is misleading.
acceptance: Test gap, invalidation and deletion.

title: Levels
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use hline for supported fixed thresholds, plot for dynamic series, line for bounded segments.
rationale: Static levels and adaptive prices are different entities.
acceptance: Change inputs and verify level lifecycle.

title: Lines and boxes
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Create/update/delete drawing IDs explicitly; choose xloc by time or bar index; cap retained objects.
rationale: Drawing quotas and stale objects can silently hide history.
acceptance: Test oldest-object deletion and timeframe switch.

title: Plots
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Declare plots globally, use na for conditional visibility, stable titles for export and alerts.
rationale: Plots form a machine-readable interface as well as chart UI.
acceptance: Check data window, CSV export and title stability.

title: Tables
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Create persistent table, update cells on last bar, calculate underlying features on all required bars.
rationale: Table values are current snapshots, not historical series.
acceptance: Compare last-bar table numbers to data-window values.

title: Text and shapes
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Choose plotshape/plotchar for repeated markers and label objects for dynamic text; limit density.
rationale: Dynamic text and historical visual offsets can mislead.
acceptance: Test confirmed event marker and optional label cleanup.

title: Alerts
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Choose alert() for dynamic payload, alertcondition for named indicator conditions, order-fill events for strategies; create alert in UI.
rationale: Alerts are snapshots of script/config and are not historical backfills.
acceptance: Capture one live payload, verify frequency and recreate after config change.

title: Bar states
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use barstate flags according to historical/live lifecycle; distinguish last from confirmed; do not rely on isconfirmed inside request.security.
rationale: A chart bar confirmation does not confirm a higher timeframe bar.
acceptance: Test first, historical, last and closing live bar.

title: Chart information
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Read symbol metadata, OHLCV, tick size and point value; qualify feed and instrument units.
rationale: Contract units and volume semantics differ.
acceptance: Test crypto, stock and missing-volume symbol.

title: Inputs
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Group data/signal/risk/UI settings; constrain ranges and document config identity.
rationale: Input changes trigger recalculation and may invalidate alerts.
acceptance: Test min/max/default and invalid combination.

title: Libraries
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Export documented typed APIs, pin library versions, test in consumer script and review licensing.
rationale: A published dependency can change behavior if upgraded.
acceptance: Compile library and a version-pinned importing script.

title: Non-standard charts data
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use ticker constructors only with explicit synthetic context; request standard prices when needed.
rationale: Heikin Ashi/Renko/etc. are not equivalent to tradeable OHLC.
acceptance: Compare synthetic vs standard data and prohibit naive fill claims.

title: Other timeframes and data
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Choose same-TF, strictly higher-TF or lower-TF route; for confirmed HTF use offset expression with lookahead_on; for LTF use intrabar arrays where appropriate.
rationale: Misalignment, lookahead and sparse bars can leak or distort information.
acceptance: Check boundary bars, gaps, no future values and empty intrabar arrays.

title: Repainting
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Classify live fluctuation, future leakage, plotting in past, data revision and intrabar irreproducibility separately.
rationale: Not every repaint is a bug, but trade timing must be honest.
acceptance: Log confirmed signals, reload and compare event times.

title: Sessions
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Set explicit session strings, days and exchange/IANA timezone; handle overnight intervals.
rationale: DST and exchange calendars change session membership.
acceptance: Test overnight, weekend and DST transition.

title: Strategies
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Define order creation and fill timing, entry/exit IDs, sizing, commission, slippage and emulator settings; use realistic prices.
rationale: Fills are modeled rather than actual executions.
acceptance: Test entry, gap, reversal, partial exits, fees and OOS performance.

title: Strings
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use str functions for formatting; distinguish const from series strings and escape JSON text.
rationale: Formatting errors break alerts and type constraints.
acceptance: Parse payload externally with quotes, null and non-ASCII fixtures.

title: Time
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Treat timestamps as Unix milliseconds, format with explicit timezone; distinguish bar open, close and observation time.
rationale: Time zone display and event ordering are different.
acceptance: Test DST, gaps and missing close time on non-time bars.

title: Timeframes
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use valid timeframe strings and compare durations only where meaningful; validate strict HTF and intended LTF.
rationale: Minutes and months have different notation and alignment.
acceptance: Test 15, 60, 1D, 1W, 1M and invalid input.

title: Style guide
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use readable names, consistent indentation, documented functions and organized source sections.
rationale: Maintainers and agents need stable interfaces.
acceptance: Review diffs for unintended semantic changes and run regression tests.

title: Debugging
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Reproduce smallest failure, log relevant values, isolate calculations from drawings and disable debug in release.
rationale: Changing many things at once obscures root cause.
acceptance: Save exact error, minimal reproduction and before/after result.

title: Profiling and optimization
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Profile first, then replace redundant requests/loops and reuse objects; compare outputs after optimization.
rationale: Compiler optimization and resource pressure are not obvious from line count.
acceptance: Record profiler settings and verify numerical parity.

title: Publishing scripts
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Review applicable publication and licensing rules; disclose limitations, settings and dependencies.
rationale: Public access is not permission to relicense another author's code.
acceptance: Verify rights, attribution and clean release before publish.

title: Limitations
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Budget unique requests, plot counts, drawing IDs, history, collections and execution time against current plan.
rationale: Limits can vary by plan and releases.
acceptance: Stress test worst-case inputs and document observed limits.

title: Overview
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Classify compilation error, warning or runtime error; capture exact code/message and consult matching help page.
rationale: The same symptom can have multiple root causes.
acceptance: Reproduce and rerun with minimal changes; do not silence warnings blindly.

title: CE10101
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Inspect non-boolean conditions; use explicit comparison or not na(value) according to intended semantics.
rationale: v6 rejects implicit numeric conditions.
acceptance: Test true, false, zero and missing numeric cases.

title: CE10117
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Reduce compiled code complexity and duplicated logic; splitting or removing real functionality may be necessary. Do not minify names/comments as a token fix.
rationale: Compiled intermediate representation, not source length, determines this limit.
acceptance: Compile a reduced reproducer and check feature parity.

title: CW10003
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Open exact warning and inspect conditional execution and historical dependencies before repair.
rationale: Warning suppression is not proof of correct time series.
acceptance: Compare against baseline with consistent per-bar evaluation where relevant.

title: CW10026
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: For inputs sharing group and inline, give only the first a nonempty title; use empty titles for the others.
rationale: Multiple titles can defeat the current input alignment rules.
acceptance: Inspect Settings/Inputs at different window sizes.

title: RE10139
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Reduce memory from cross-context collection returns, oversized historical buffers and unnecessary drawing updates; return scalar aggregates when possible.
rationale: Copies of requested collections can consume memory on every bar.
acceptance: Stress test long history, multiple contexts and maximum inputs.

title: RE10143
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Trace largest history offset; size the relevant series buffer explicitly only as needed and guard dynamic offsets.
rationale: Realtime offsets can exceed the buffer inferred during historical loading.
acceptance: Test maximum offset on historical and realtime/replay data.

title: General
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Check FAQ for platform capabilities and distinguish Pine code from UI configuration.
rationale: Some user goals cannot be solved in Pine alone.
acceptance: State supported path or external dependency.

title: Alerts
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Audit alert creation, snapshot, placeholders, frequency and realtime eligibility.
rationale: A correct script does not automatically create active alerts.
acceptance: Verify actual alert log plus receiver log.

title: Data structures
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Choose scalar, array, map, matrix or UDT based on access pattern and lifetime.
rationale: Unnecessary collections add memory and aliasing risk.
acceptance: Test insert/read/delete and memory bound.

title: Functions
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Inspect scope, qualifiers, history and return type; use FAQ recipes only after version check.
rationale: Function examples may hide call-context assumptions.
acceptance: Add small function-specific probe.

title: Indicators
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Specify indicator formula, units, inputs and warm-up before using a recipe.
rationale: Names alone do not ensure matching formula.
acceptance: Compare to known benchmark values and document differences.

title: Other data and timeframes
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Check TF relationship, gaps, symbol context and confirmation before reusing a request example.
rationale: Cross-context data is a common leakage path.
acceptance: Run HTF boundary/LTF empty-array checks.

title: Programming
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Prefer minimal idiomatic solution and verify platform restrictions for generic programming requests.
rationale: Pine is not a general-purpose application runtime.
acceptance: Compile a minimal implementation with boundary cases.

title: Strategies
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use documented order/sizing examples as probes, not profitability evidence.
rationale: Broker emulator behavior differs from broker execution.
acceptance: Inspect order list and test fees, gap and reversals.

title: Strings and formatting
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Specify numeric precision, tick rounding and text escaping separately.
rationale: Display rounding should not change raw features.
acceptance: Round-trip exported JSON and compare original raw value.

title: Techniques
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Turn each technique into an explicit hypothesis, algorithm and test; avoid undocumented shortcuts.
rationale: Visual plausibility does not establish correct signal timing.
acceptance: Test synthetic sequence and live/reload behavior.

title: Times, dates, and sessions
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use exchange/IANA timezone and explicit session policy; separate calendar from timestamp arithmetic.
rationale: Day boundaries vary by instrument and location.
acceptance: Test DST, holiday gap and overnight session.

title: Variables and operators
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Trace value type, qualifier, scope, lifetime and history reference.
rationale: Common bugs arise from reassignment or missing values.
acceptance: Test first bar, reset and branch behavior.

title: Visuals
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Use chart UI FAQ for placement, scale, colors and drawing constraints; keep UI optional.
rationale: Visual clutter and scale distortions impair usability.
acceptance: Test theme, zoom, overlay/pane and data-window parity.

title: Release notes
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Review current release notes before adopting new API; record publication and verification dates separately.
rationale: v6 runtime evolves without a new major language version.
acceptance: Compile a small new-feature probe and record plan/feed requirements.

title: Overview
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Migrate one major version at a time; save source and baseline for every stage.
rationale: Conversion success does not prove signal equivalence.
acceptance: Compare output series and orders at each stage.

title: To Pine Script version 6
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Audit booleans, lazy and/or, dynamic requests, integer division, loop bounds and strategy defaults/exit behavior.
rationale: v6 can change semantics even when the code compiles.
acceptance: Test old/new outputs, especially branches, HTF requests and fills.

title: To Pine Script version 5
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Map study to indicator, legacy namespaces, specialized inputs, named constants, transparency and session days.
rationale: Renaming alone misses default and type changes.
acceptance: Compare session coverage and numerical outputs.

title: To Pine Script version 4
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Check renamed built-ins, typed inputs, declaration/reassignment and object APIs against exact migration guide.
rationale: Legacy syntax and state initialization differ.
acceptance: Compile preserved baseline and converted script.

title: To Pine Script version 3
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Review security lookahead changes and self-referencing variable conversions.
rationale: Legacy HTF data may contain future information.
acceptance: Compare signals at HTF boundaries and distinguish intentional corrections.

title: To Pine Script version 2
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Consult historical migration guide; preserve original code and explicitly inspect each legacy construct.
rationale: Modern documentation may not describe historical semantics fully.
acceptance: Record unavailable legacy compiler evidence instead of assuming parity.

title: Where can I get more information?
applies_to: v6; legacy only after version-specific verification
action: Prefer official reference, language manual and release notes; use community only for discovery and verify licensing.
rationale: Community snippets can be outdated or incorrect.
acceptance: Attach source and independent probe to each accepted claim.
